mapper.update: UPDATE project_stage ps INNER JOIN project p ON p.project_id = ps.project_id AND p.is_delete = 0 SET ps.stage_output = #{stageOutput}, ps.updated_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE p.project_type = #{projectTypeId} AND ps.stage_name = #{stageName} AND ps.is_delete = 0 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM output_value ov WHERE ov.project_stage_id = ps.project_stage_id AND ov.is_delete = 0 )
